backends.what: ShopRaha's grocery e-commerce backend: a fork of Saleor extended with Kuwait-specific modules (delivery slots, wallets/cashback, recipes, marketing campaigns, SAP/Odoo/Swisslog SynQ warehouse integrations, Tap payments).
Last-mile delivery operations backend for the Cockpit dashboard: drivers, vehicles, work schedules, zones/areas (GIS), delivery time slots, routes and delivery tasks.
B2B fulfilment platform API that opens the ShopRaha warehouse to multiple merchant clients for storage, order fulfilment, last-mile delivery and billing (incl. a Shopify integration and webhooks).
Halo, BTR Tech's warehouse management system (WMS) backend: inventory, bin locations, products/attributes, inbound/outbound operations and orders.
Rover, BTR Tech's last-mile delivery backend (successor to cockpit): drivers, delivery slots, geolocation zones and delivery tasks for the Rover driver app and dashboard.

Infrastructure-as-code for ShopRaha: Terraform (Terraform Cloud) stacks for AWS (ECS, Aurora, Redis, RabbitMQ, ETL/Glue/Athena, monitoring, smooth-api) plus Cloudflare Access/DNS and GitHub providers.
stack: AWS (ECS, Aurora, ElastiCache, Lambda, Glue, Athena, IAM, CloudWatch)

backends.what: Tiny Cloudflare Worker that renders any URL passed in the query string as an SVG QR code.
Edge cache Worker ('faster-graphql-queries') that hashes ShopRaha GraphQL POST bodies with SHA-256 and caches storefront query responses in Workers KV, bypassing dashboard/cockpit origins.
"Smooth Logistics" Shopify app (built from Shopify's Node template) that lets merchant stores hand orders and fulfilment to BTR Tech's Smooth fulfilment platform.
Bun monorepo of BTR Tech's Ionic/Capacitor mobile apps: Rover (last-mile driver app) and Pickr (warehouse picking app), with a shared lib package.
